title: Problem
问题
html: Primary sources: ACL Anthology paper 2024.findings-acl.91, Findings of ACL 2024, pages 1552-1587, DOI 10.18653/v1/2024.findings-acl.91, plus arXiv:2402.14809 and the official project page. CriticBench asks how well LLMs can critique and correct reasoning, not only generate final answers. The evaluation surface is a generation-critique-correction record over five domains: mathematical, commonsense, symbolic, coding, and algorithmic reasoning. It belongs in the atlas as a judge/reward/meta-evaluation benchmark for feedback quality, not as a verified program-execution dataset. The evidence boundary is the authors' curated benchmark, prompts, reference labels/metrics, and reported model evaluations.

一手来源是 ACL Anthology 2024.findings-acl.91，Findings of ACL 2024，页码 1552-1587，DOI 10.18653/v1/2024.findings-acl.91，另有 arXiv:2402.14809 和官方项目页。CriticBench 问的是 LLM 能否 critique 并 correct 自己或他人的 reasoning，而不只是生成最终答案。评测面是 generation-critique-correction record，覆盖 mathematical、commonsense、symbolic、coding、algorithmic 五个 reasoning domain。它应作为反馈质量的 judge/reward/meta-evaluation benchmark 收录，不是程序执行 verifier 数据集。证据边界在作者构造的 benchmark、prompt、参考标签/指标和模型评测。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: CriticBench contributes a benchmark for GQC reasoning: generation, critique, and correction. The ACL/arXiv abstract states that it compiles 15 datasets, incorporates responses from three LLM families, and evaluates 17 LLMs across five reasoning domains. The core mechanism is to present model-generated reasoning or answers, ask for critiques and corrections, and score the quality of the critique-correct pipeline with task-specific references or metrics. Closest comparisons are answer-only reasoning benchmarks and critique/self-improvement methods such as CRITIC/ToRA; CriticBench changes the object to the feedback step itself. The feedback contract is judgment-based and metric-based, not a mechanical proof checker.

CriticBench 的贡献是一个 GQC reasoning benchmark：generation、critique、correction。ACL/arXiv 摘要说明它汇集 15 个 datasets，纳入 3 个 LLM families 的 responses，并在五个 reasoning domains 上评测 17 个 LLM。核心机制是给模型生成的推理或答案，让模型提出 critique 和 correction，再用任务专属参考或指标评价 critique-correct pipeline。最近对比对象是只看最终答案的 reasoning benchmark，以及 CRITIC/ToRA 等 critique/self-improvement 方法；CriticBench 把对象转向反馈步骤本身。反馈契约是 judgment/metric-based，不是机械 proof checker。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Inputs: task prompt, initial model response or reasoning, domain label, source dataset, and reference answer or judging criterion.
  2. Pipeline: evaluate generation, request critique of the response/reasoning, request correction, and compare corrected output against task-specific references or scoring rules.
  3. Outputs: generation result, critique text, corrected answer, domain/task metadata, and GQC metrics.
  4. Feedback: benchmark labels, answer keys, domain metrics, and model-judgment procedures where disclosed determine scores; there is no universal executable verifier.
  5. Reproducibility: pin dataset version, prompt templates, sampled model responses, evaluated model version, decoding settings, scoring scripts, and whether a result is self-critique or inter-model critique.

1. 输入：任务 prompt、初始模型回答或推理、domain label、来源 dataset，以及参考答案或 judging criterion。
  2. 流程：先评估 generation，再要求模型 critique 该回答/推理，再要求 correction，并把修正输出同任务专属参考或评分规则比较。
  3. 输出：generation 结果、critique 文本、corrected answer、domain/task 元数据和 GQC 指标。
  4. 反馈：benchmark 标签、答案键、domain metric，以及论文披露的 model-judgment procedure 给分；不存在统一可执行 verifier。
  5. 复现需固定 dataset 版本、prompt template、采样模型 responses、被评测模型版本、decoding 设置、scoring scripts，并区分 self-critique 与 inter-model critique。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The ACL abstract reports four main findings: GQC abilities correlate linearly, critique-focused training improves performance, correction effectiveness varies by task with logic-oriented tasks more amenable, inconsistencies decrease with model size, and stronger models tend to critique weaker ones better while weaker models can outperform stronger ones in self-critique. The benchmark scale evidence is 15 datasets, five domains, responses from three LLM families, and evaluation of 17 LLMs. Row-level evidence is the prompt, original response, critique, corrected answer, and scoring result. Evidence is bounded by prompt design, response sampling, metric validity, and any model-as-judge choices.

ACL 摘要报告了几类主要发现：GQC 能力近似线性相关，critique-focused training 提升表现，correction effectiveness 依任务而变且逻辑类任务更易被修正，知识不一致随模型规模增大而下降，强模型更会 critique 弱模型但弱模型在 self-critique 中可能反超强模型。规模证据是 15 个 datasets、五个 domain、3 个 LLM families 的 responses、17 个 LLM 的评测。单条证据是 prompt、原始 response、critique、corrected answer 和 scoring result。证据受 prompt 设计、response 采样、metric 有效性和 model-as-judge 选择约束。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The prior baseline is final-answer reasoning evaluation or method papers showing that critique can improve outputs. CriticBench changes the benchmark object to the critique-correct loop and evaluates generation, critique, and correction as separable capabilities across domains. The direction signal is feedback-quality measurement for self-improvement and evaluator design. The quality signal is cross-domain coverage, multiple source datasets, multiple response families, and published ACL metadata with project/data links. Critique prompting and answer-key scoring are not new. Reuse requires auditing source dataset licenses, split provenance, prompt templates, generated-response lineage, judging rules, and contamination from public reasoning benchmarks.

已有基线多是最终答案 reasoning 评测，或证明 critique 能改善输出的方法论文。CriticBench 把 benchmark 对象改成 critique-correct loop，并把 generation、critique、correction 当作可分开的能力跨 domain 评估。方向信号是 self-improvement 和 evaluator design 所需的反馈质量测量。质量信号是跨 domain 覆盖、多来源 dataset、多 response family，以及 ACL 正式元数据和项目/数据链接。critique prompting 和答案键评分本身并不新。复用前要审来源 dataset license、split provenance、prompt template、生成 response 谱系、judging rules 和公开 reasoning benchmark 污染。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Correctness is only relative to the task-specific labels or metrics. A fluent critique can be wrong, incomplete, or persuasive without improving the corrected answer. Aggregate GQC correlation does not certify an individual critique as a reliable reward signal. Public reasoning datasets and generated responses can leak into later models. Domain metrics are heterogeneous, so mathematical, coding, commonsense, symbolic, and algorithmic scores should not be collapsed without checking their scoring contracts.

正确性只相对于任务专属标签或指标成立。流畅 critique 可能错误、不完整，或虽然有说服力却没有改善 corrected answer。GQC aggregate correlation 不能证明单条 critique 可作为可靠 reward signal。公开 reasoning datasets 和生成 responses 可能进入后续模型训练。各 domain 指标异质，数学、代码、常识、符号和算法分数不能在未检查评分契约时直接合并。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use CriticBench as a schema for feedback records: task, domain, source dataset, original response, critique, corrected response, critique target, self-versus-other relation, scoring rule, and final metric. It is useful for evaluating critic models, reward-model candidates, self-correction pipelines, and judge calibration. For atlas reuse, preserve whether the feedback is explanatory, corrective, preference-like, or scalar-scored, because those contracts support different downstream uses.

可把 CriticBench 作为反馈记录 schema：任务、domain、source dataset、original response、critique、corrected response、critique target、self/other 关系、评分规则和最终指标。它适合评估 critic model、reward-model candidate、self-correction pipeline 和 judge calibration。atlas 复用时要保留反馈是 explanatory、corrective、preference-like 还是 scalar-scored，因为这些契约支持的下游用途不同。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Keep generation, critique, and correction separate. A model may generate well but critique poorly, or critique another model better than itself. Do not treat a critique as ground truth unless the task-specific scoring rule supports it. Read domain-wise results before aggregate GQC claims; logic-oriented correction behavior may not transfer to commonsense or open-ended tasks.

要把 generation、critique 和 correction 分开看。一个模型可能生成强但 critique 弱，也可能 critique 别的模型比 critique 自己更好。除非任务专属评分规则支持，不要把 critique 当 ground truth。读 aggregate GQC claim 前先看 domain-wise 结果；逻辑类任务的 correction 行为不一定迁移到常识或开放任务。
